name: Gasthof Dorferwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Dorferwirt is located in a quiet village in Tirol. The atmosphere is traditional and down-to-earth. Guests can expect simply furnished rooms and a Tiroler Gastküche. The surrounding area offers opportunities for hiking and skiing. The amenities include a restaurant with a terrace and free parking. The service is personal and uncomplicated.
